name: Domenico Prostamo
evidence: Named twice: as «fu Domenico, marinaro» in his son Alfonso's marriage proclamation of January 1886 and marriage of May 1887, with his death certificate produced; and as the father of a Prostamo daughter marrying in 1880. Dead before January 1886. Married Giovanna Ventrice, filatrice, who was alive in 1886 and consented in person.

name: Alfonso Prostamo
evidence: Aged 24 in January 1886 and 25 in May 1887, so born about 1862, not 1858 as the tree says. A MARINARO — a sailor, not a contadino. Married Caterina Melluso, 21, daughter of Leone Melluso, on 21 May 1887 at Briatico.
